provenance.rn_normalization: primary/target split: dcml_parser._split_rntxt_applied; degree+suffix: compare_rn.normalise_rn + split_rn (degree case = mode color, suffix verbatim); quality: compare_rn.extract_quality (pinned, coarse on WiR slashed figures). normalized class = 'degree | quality | figure | target'.

raw_unnormalized.rule: compare_rn.split_rn returned None (degree unparseable, e.g. It6/Ger/Fr/N/Cad).

normalization_gaps.note: compare_rn.extract_quality is coarse on WiR's slash-spelled notation (the pinned instrument, reused as-is). Figure info is preserved verbatim in the class 'figure' field, so classes do NOT wrongly merge; only the coarse 'quality' token is affected. Surfaced for Cowork; not built around.

transitions_same_key.rule: adjacent regions with an identical resolved local key (tonic_pc, mode); key-change boundaries excluded (counted in key_changes). Label = the normalized class; pair = 'from  =>  to'.

key_changes.rule: adjacent regions whose resolved local key (tonic_pc, mode) differs; keyed by (circle-of-fifths tonic distance, from_mode->to_mode).

entry_chords.rule: the first label after each key change (the region entering the new key).

sensitive_cells.rule: desk-sim §4.3 named cells; same-key adjacent raw-label pairs; each predicate stated below (raw label space).

V6_to_vihalfdim.predicate: from V (maj color) figure exactly '6'; to VI (min color) with '/o' half-dim sigil

vihalfdim_to_IV.predicate: from VI (min color) with '/o' sigil; to IV (maj color)

i_to_IVraised6.predicate: minor local key; from i (I min color); to IV (maj color = raised 6th degree)

vi_to_appliedTo_vi.predicate: from vi (VI min color); to any chord applied to VI (target base == VI)

applied_not_resolving_to_target.predicate: from an applied chord (target present); to a chord whose degree base != target base

V_to_vi.predicate: from V (maj color), not applied; to VI (any color), not applied (deceptive)

excluded.boundary_metric_position_tables: gated on OI-184 (the WiR anacrusis beat-alignment convention must be positively established before per-beat/boundary counts are drawn); NOT counted here.
